annotations.title: Stateless Consent & One-Click Unsubscribe Tokens API (verify)

description: Stateless Consent & One-Click Unsubscribe Tokens API (verify): Issue and verify stateless HMAC unsubscribe tokens and RFC 8058 List-Unsubscribe headers. (Endpoint: POST /v1/consent-tokens/verify)

expected_scope.description: Optional scope that must match the token payload's `scope` claim.

keys.description: Map of kid -> secret for key rotation.

now_epoch.description: Optional Unix epoch timestamp in seconds used as current time for expiration checks.

secret.description: Single signing secret (if not using keys map).

token.description: Signed compact consent token (`<header>.<payload>.<signature>`) to verify.

name: tinplate_consent_tokens_verify
